a.cookie.body:
Claude quotas are read from claude.ai using your session. Each account has its own cookie and its own isolated session.

1. Open claude.ai/settings/usage in your browser, signed in to THIS account.
2. Developer Tools (⌥⌘I) → Network tab, then reload (⌘R).
3. Filter on “usage” and click the request of the same name.
4. Right-click it → Copy → Copy as cURL.
5. Paste it as is below: Status will extract only the cookie.

⚠️ This cookie is equivalent to full access to the account. It is stored in this Mac’s Keychain, is only sent to claude.ai, and expires at your next sign-out.
a.cookie.placeholder: Paste the cURL (or the raw cookie)
a.cookie.title: claude.ai session cookie (unofficial)

api.estimateNote: Neither Anthropic nor OpenAI publishes the credit balance through an API. Status reads daily costs (published about 5 minutes late) and estimates what is left: entered balance minus costs since then, or monthly budget minus this month's costs. More than 400 days after entry, enter the balance again.

api.key.body.openai: Admin key (sk-admin-…), created by the organization owner in Organization → Admin keys. Pick read-only if the page offers it, and a key just for Status. It stays in this Mac's Keychain and is only sent to api.openai.com.

api.key.invalid.openai: This is not an OpenAI admin key: it must start with sk-admin-. A project key gives no access to costs.

fan.desc: Speed set to 60%, 80% or the Mac’s maximum, never below the current speed, for 15 to 60 minutes. Status takes over from macOS thermal management for the duration of the boost, then hands it back: at expiry, if Status stops responding, or if the Mac heats up to a partial threshold. If macOS refuses, the boost is canceled.
